lines: Pink colors, dressed-up blossoms begin to paint the town
"Soon now," "yes, soon" — the two of us wait impatiently
Spring is coming, it's almost here — how many springs has it been?
Forever, I want it to be the two of us — softly, I addressed it to the sky
The first love letter I ever wrote, so frustrating (my first love letter)
The wonder of a warmth that won't cool (the wonder of that warmth)
A love song for the future
The eternity I longed for the more I imagined it hurts
Unable to hide it, I laugh it off
See? See you again — I "fall in like with you"
Even the loneliness of passing each other by is packed with longing
To the one so dear to me, thank you — words aren't enough, are they
A love song for the future
The fleetingness that swells in me each time I sing with you hurts
Scenery I've never seen crosses with the present
See? See you again — that day too, I "fell in like with you"
The synchronicity born when we're unconscious (unconscious synchronicity)
A certain love is invincible (love is invincible)
A love song for the future
The eternity I longed for the more I imagined it hurts
Unable to hide it, I laugh it off
See? See you again — I "fall in like with the two of us"
